name: Goal Setting and Monitoring
description: Agent explicitly formulates measurable goals, tracks progress against those goals, and adapts its plan when deviation or new information is detected. Separates the what (goal) from the how (plan) and provides an evaluation loop for autonomous behavior.
when_to_use: Long-horizon tasks where intermediate feedback is sparse
Autonomous agents operating without human steering
Scenarios requiring self-correction when plans fail
Tasks where success criteria are explicit and measurable
drawbacks: Goal specification is brittle for ambiguous tasks
Risk of reward hacking on poorly specified goals
use_cases: Deep research agents checking sub-question coverage
Autonomous coding agents tracking test-pass counts
Robotics and embodied agents monitoring mission completion
Multi-day enterprise workflows with milestone checkpoints

typescript.description: Goal monitor triggers replan when metrics regress.

relationships.description: Plan serves the goal; goal informs plan revision
